Class FrameEvent

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.window.input.FrameEvent
public class FrameEvent extends Object
Reusable, consumable input gathered for one hosted render frame.

This is not an immutable event log. The default dispatcher clears consumed button, wheel, key, and text fields. Wrappers can handle a callback without forwarding it to the underlying screen.

Key objects are preallocated and overwritten on later frames. Consumers must copy values they need to keep and must not retain this frame as a snapshot.
